notes.title: Some Incredible News from the MoonPunch Team
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We're thrilled to finally share some significant news with you all. For us, this is a genuine ‘pinch-yourself’ moment that we’re incredibly excited to announce. Our passion project, Gangs Of Asia “GOA” is officially partnering with the [b]legendary MicroProse[/b] as our publisher.[/p][p][/p][p]To say we’re honored is an understatement.[/p][p]For those who have followed our story, you’ll know that [b]MoonPunch[/b] has been a core part of our lives for the better part of a decade. For nine years, this project has been built in our spare time with a custom engine and hand drawn pixels by just the two of us, a couple of game development veterans who wanted to create something from the ground up that we’d love to play.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627361/8e820e386e70f3b1a1801e8b9664d873102a9c55.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Our goal with MoonPunch has always been to make a game that’s [b]uniquely fun[/b], especially with friends. [/p][p]It’s designed to be the kind of experience that sparks laughter and friendly competition, something you can enjoy for hours on end.[/p][p]That’s why this partnership with MicroProse feels so perfect. We both grew up when the MicroProse name on a game box meant you were getting something different and special. Their titles weren’t mass-produced; they were innovative and had a distinct quality.[/p][p]
Seeing MicroProse return to champion independent developers and unique gameplay ideas is fantastic for the entire industry. In a climate that can often feel driven by large-scale corporate interests, their focus on creativity and passion is a welcome return to form. They truly seem to understand what it takes to bring a unique vision to life. We are incredibly humbled and grateful for this opportunity. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627361/7b32d5a3b1df8ac5e26f97f84d7b5705c3744675.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The team at MicroProse shares our vision, and with their support, we're looking forward to finally getting GOA into your hands.[/p][p]This is a massive milestone for our small team, and we want to extend a huge thank you to everyone who has supported us on this long journey. Your encouragement has been a constant source of motivation.[/p][p]Get ready for what's to come. We can't wait to share more with you soon.[/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]The MoonPunch Team[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]
